compute_mask_areas: compute areas of binary masks stored as [N, height, width] uint8 numpy arrays
compute_pairwise_intersection: compute pairwise intersection areas between two collections of binary masks
compute_pairwise_iou: compute pairwise intersection-over-union scores between two collections of binary masks
compute_pairwise_ioa: compute pairwise intersection-over-area scores between two collections of binary masks
validate_mask_dtype: validate that mask arrays are of type np.uint8 before performing mask operations
